Rime: Alacritty settings carried over to Ghostty


Carried over:
  keyboard.bindings[0] key='Return' mods='Shift' chars='\x1b\r'
    -> keybind = shift+enter=text:\x1b\r

Same as Rime's default, so not copied:
  (nothing)

Not carried over:

    Ghostty has no hints; it finds URLs itself and opens one on Ctrl+click

Alacritty is still installed and its files were not changed.
